title.narrative: Strengthening Protection Mechanisms for Preventing and Responding to Trafficking in Persons and Smuggling of Migrants

description.narrative: This project will help reduce trafficking and related exploitation in Zimbabwe by improving prevention, early identification, and referral to protection services in high-risk locations. It will work with communities, frontline officials, and local support centres to increase public awareness of deceptive recruitment practices, unsafe migration risks, and available reporting channels. The project will also strengthen the ability of key responders to identify people at risk, respond safely and appropriately, and connect them to support through national systems. Activities will include community outreach, radio and digital messaging, easy-to-understand information materials in local languages, workshops with trusted local leaders, and practical training for frontline staff. By focusing on women, young people, and other vulnerable groups, the project aims to reduce exposure to exploitation, improve access to protection, and support stronger coordination across government and community structures. It will contribute to safer migration, better protection of people at risk, and a more effective national response to human trafficking in Zimbabwe.
